import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "f108fa2765a922f800c9cc87e99eab11b629839e"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=env)

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
status = run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} status={status!r}")

cli = wt / "src/do_again/cli.py"
text = cli.read_text()
text = text.replace('''    print("SETUP_OK")
''','''    print("SETUP_CONFIGURED")
    print("verification=not_run")
''',1)
cli.write_text(text)

test = wt / "tests/test_cli.py"
t = test.read_text()
if 'self.assertNotIn("SETUP_OK", output.getvalue())' not in t:
    marker = '''            self.assertIn("browser = true", (repo / "do-again.toml").read_text())

    def test_setup_no_browser_disables_existing_browser_setting(self) -> None:
'''
    replacement = '''            self.assertIn("browser = true", (repo / "do-again.toml").read_text())
            self.assertIn("SETUP_CONFIGURED", output.getvalue())
            self.assertIn("verification=not_run", output.getvalue())
            self.assertNotIn("SETUP_OK", output.getvalue())

    def test_setup_no_browser_disables_existing_browser_setting(self) -> None:
'''
    if marker not in t:
        raise SystemExit("test marker not found")
    t = t.replace(marker, replacement, 1)

    marker2 = '''            with patch("do_again.cli.service_status", return_value=fake_status):
                rc = setup_project(str(repo), install_background=False, browser=False)
            self.assertEqual(rc, 0)
            self.assertIn("browser = false", (repo / "do-again.toml").read_text())
'''
    replacement2 = '''            output = io.StringIO()
            with patch("do_again.cli.service_status", return_value=fake_status), redirect_stdout(output):
                rc = setup_project(str(repo), install_background=False, browser=False)
            self.assertEqual(rc, 0)
            self.assertIn("browser = false", (repo / "do-again.toml").read_text())
            self.assertIn("SETUP_CONFIGURED", output.getvalue())
            self.assertIn("verification=not_run", output.getvalue())
            self.assertNotIn("SETUP_OK", output.getvalue())
'''
    if marker2 not in t:
        raise SystemExit("no-browser test marker not found")
    t = t.replace(marker2, replacement2, 1)
test.write_text(t)

env = os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(wt/"src")
focused = run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_cli"], check=False, env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print(f"focused_rc={focused.returncode}")
if focused.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py"])
commit = run(["git","commit","-m","Stop reporting unverified setup as ready"], check=False)
print(commit.stdout)
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)
print("new_head=" + run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status=" + repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
